{{Quote|I think it's occasionally good for us to remember that being a smuggler doesn't necessarily require one to be a barbarian, too.|[[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="HttE" />}}
'''Car'das''', sometimes called the '''Car'das smugglers''', was a syndicate of criminals founded by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]]. The Car'das were involved in various criminal activities but their main business was smuggling and information brokering. More interested in profit, they usually avoided violent criminal activities and had a reputation of civilized and honorable criminals. Thanks to the talented Jorj Car'das, the organization became one of the major smuggling rings in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Jorj Car'das mysteriously vanished and the organization was taken over by one of his lieutenants, [[Talon Karrde]]. '''Karrde's Organization''' continued to growth under its new leader, particularly during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era. Talon Karrde ruled the organization during the Galactic Civil War, the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Throughout these troubled times, Talon Karrde successfully preserved Jorj Car'das' tradition of respectable criminals among the members of the syndicate.

==Organization==
{{Quote|You can't even call your wife on a comlink without Talon Karrde hearing about it.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TEGtVaV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
Car'das were one of the major [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] syndicates in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Car'das smugglers usually received the best cargoes with high profitability, as well as access to numerous resources that made smuggling easier. Other criminal organizations, like the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clans, disliked Car'das' ability to move on their turf and tried to harm the organization.<ref name="TFUCG" /> Contrary to other criminal organization that used smuggling as part of their primary business, Car'das smugglers did not produce the goods they transported and rather smuggled third-party goods and information. The Car'das avoided [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade.<ref name="FC">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

[[File:Wildkarrde.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''[[Wild Karrde]]'', flagship of the Car'das smuggling fleet after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].]]
The Car'das smugglers controlled many smuggling operations in the galaxy and were also engaged in small-scale [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and other criminal activities. Though not usually considered to be violent criminals, its hardened members weren't afraid to shoot their way out of a hard situation. The Car'das were more concerned with turning a profit rather than engaging in violent criminal activity. Its members were required to be as intelligent as they were bold, for Jorj Car'das had little tolerance for non-intelligent actions of fools who very quickly got kicked out of the organization. However, the greed and ambition of Jorj Car'das often found its way down to individual members, and many of the Car'das members simply left the organization to make fortune for themselves. Since the majority of Car'das operations involved smuggling, most of its members were high-skilled [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], although [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], [[Mercenary/Legends|hired blasters]] and other criminals were also a common sight in the organization. Its members had access to private [[Shadowport/Legends|shadow]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], where they could lay down and make repairs until the attention of the authorities shifted to another target.<ref name="TFUCG" />

[[File:Cardas_officer.png|thumb|right|150px|A Car'das officer]]
The Car'das were organized into smaller cells that operated in particular [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and regions throughout the galaxy. Though each cell was operating semi-independently, they still reported to the central organization led by Car'das himself. The cells consisted of individual [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and their crews, each ship having its own and hierarchy and its own [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Hierarchy and organization among Car'das members were based on their position in smuggling ships. Below captains, Car'das ranks included, from the highest to the lowest, [[Executive officer/Legends|first officers]], [[Officer/Legends|officer]], and simple crewmembers.<ref name="TFUCG" /> First officers could serve as aide to a captain but more often had their own ship and crew, though under the orders of the captain of another ship. Only captains directly reported to Jorj Car'das. Officers commanded crewmembers aboard Car'das ships, themselves under the leadership of captains and first officers. Crewmembers included various specialized occupations required to ship daily operations such as pilots and technicians. Among crewmembers, certain individuals could bear the ranks of [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] and [[Helm officer/Legends|helmsman]], that were purely honorific.<ref name="TFUCG" />

Car'das smugglers made use of various types of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to carry their smuggling missions.<ref name="TFUCG" /> In addition, they also used [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to defend their bases<ref name="SWG:BJS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Bright Jewel system}}</ref> and protect their operations, each Car'das cell possessing a small wing of about five starfighters.<ref name="TFUCG" /> The most frequently used models of starfighters were [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]] and [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:BJS" />

==History==
===The rise of Jorj Car'das===
{{Quote|To the Clone Wars era and the chaos that it brought on the galaxy. There was a great need for smuggling during the conflict and afterward, of necessities as well as contraband, and a large number of organizations were hastily and rather haphazardly thrown together.|[[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Jorj.jpg|thumb|left|175px|[[Jorj Car'das]] during the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' incident.]]
The creation of the Car'das syndicate was based on an idea conceived by [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], aide to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]]. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Doriana, Thrawn and the young [[Jorj Car'das]] found themselves involved in the [[Battle for Outbound Flight|destruction]] of the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. During this brief time together, the three agreed with supporting the [[Grand Plan/Legends|rise to power]] of Darth Sidious, the best way in their opinion to protect the galaxy from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Kinman Doriana and Thrawn decided to create a private information network for Sidious that would be operated by Jorj Car'das. After Doriana and Car'das returned to the known galaxy, Palpatine's aide trained the young smuggler during several months and provided money and contacts to support the foundation and growth of Car'das' information network. The network was covered as a smuggling ring and only Jorj Car'das was aware of the real goal of the organization.<ref name="OF" />

Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Jorj Car'das was in control of a smuggling ring that gained some notoriety in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TFUCG" /> During the [[Bpfassh Uprising]] of the Clone Wars, Jorj Car'das was captured by [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. The smuggler was later rescued by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] who [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] the young man. During this time the smuggler developed a latent [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|108|Car'das, Jorj}}</ref> Several months after his disappearance, Car'das returned a changed man, having precognitive abilities. Using his new insights and intuition, he expanded his criminal empire throughout the Outer Rim and beyond, becoming one of the most important smuggling rings in the galaxy. At some point, Jorj Car'das consumed the organization of [[Booster Terrik]], when the latter was sent to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

Jorj Car'das disappeared again in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="TNEGtC" /> Still suffering from his encounter with the Bpfasshi Dark Jedi, the man followed the advice of Master Yoda and joined the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] monks in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> After three months with no news from Car'das, his lieutenants realized that their boss would not come back this time. The lieutenants therefore began to discuss the future of the organization. However, it appeared quickly that none of them would be eager to let the control of the organization to another. Hence, it was suggested that the organization could simply be split up with each lieutenant preserving is area of influence. Disgusted by the idea that Car'das' organization could disappear, one of his lieutenants, [[Talon Karrde]], decided to take over the Car'das syndicate. In one single night, Karrde eliminated or neutralized all other lieutenants and assumed command of the Car'das smugglers. Despite eight different attempt by the ousted lieutenants to drive Karrde out, the man succeeded in consolidating his position over the three next years.<ref name="VotF" />

===Under Talon Karrde===
{{Quote|Talon Karrde is one of the major players in the underworld; most folks just don't know it, and that's not an accident. He's picked up a rep as one of the few infochants [&hellip;] that a sentient with credits can actually trust&mdash;more than average, that is.|[[Wrenga Jixton]]|<ref name="Underworld">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_of_Tansarii_Point_Station.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Car'das and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] starfighters dogfighting during the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Car'das were based on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:TPS" /> From the station, they patrolled the entire star system and provided protection against pirates to travelers and honest workers such as the [[Dynath Miners]].<ref name="SWG:BJS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a series of skirmishes with Black Sun pirates in [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] space turned to open war with Black Sun forces openly attacking Tansarii Point Station. Finally, Car'das pilots managed to defeat Black Sun in the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]] with the help of a number of bold [[Spacer/Legends|star-hoppers]].<ref name="SWG:DE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Darkveil Eclipse|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> Around the same time, the Car'das were also in conflict with the [[Rak'qua]], a tribe of bellicose [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]] who had taken over the Car'das research facility in the Bright Jewel system.<ref name="SWG:SG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=space_poi|Station Gamma|Bright Jewel system}}</ref> Eventually, Officer [[Antom Moria]] discovered the involvement of a local arms dealer in the outbreak of the conflict and was finally able through negotiation to convince both parties that the war was meaningless.<ref name="SWG:PaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Preventing a War|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

Talon Karrde's syndicate expanded significantly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The death of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] generated hundreds of new contacts and markets, allowing the Car'das to become the most powerful criminal organization in the Outer Rim. During this period of time, Karrde absorbed [[Quelev Tapper]]'s smuggling ring and Tapper became Karrde's second-in-command.<ref name="TNEGtC" /> The Car'das syndicate then became the largest smuggling ring in the galaxy, a position that Karrde kept secret to most people but his business partners.<ref name="TKC">{{JournalCite|7|The Kaal Connection}}</ref> Around this time, the Car'das counted over eight hundred members and nearly two dozen ships.<ref name="TSA">{{GamerCite|3|The Smugglers Alliance}}</ref> Over time, memories of Jorj Car'das as the original leader of the organization faded away.<ref name="VotF" />

After the death of Tapper on [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Karrde encountered a woman who would became his new second-in-command: [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].<ref name="TNEGtC" /> In addition to Jade, Karrde's most trusted lieutenants and associates included [[Aves]], [[Dankin]], [[Chin]], [[Fynn Torve]], [[Wadewarn]] and [[Zakarisz Ghent]].<ref name="HttES" />

[[File:Karrde_group.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Talon Karrde]] and his lieutenants on [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].]]
As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] raged, the Car'das smugglers remained neutral in the conflict but sold information to both factions.<ref name="HttES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> However, Talon Karrde found himself directly involved in the war during the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] and was forced to align with the New Republic against the Empire.<ref name="HttE" /><ref name="DFR" /> Karrde and other smuggler leaders later founded the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] that was pivotal in the defeat of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]].<ref name="TLC" /> In the following years, Karrde remained an important ally of the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] and the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="TNEGtC" />

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], during the last days of the Galactic Civil War, Talon Karrde [[Hunt for Jorj Car'das|traveled]] to the Kathol sector where he finally found his old mentor Jorj Car'das on the planet [[Exocron]]. Karrde was seeking a copy of the [[Caamas Document]] in order to end the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] but Car'das, although he possessed one of the most extensive information databases in the galaxy, did not have such copy. Nevertheless, Car'das provided sensitive information that helped solve the crisis.<ref name="VotF" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Car'das smugglers were involved in the fight against the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|extra-galactic invaders]], although many other criminal organizations sided with the Yuuzhan Vong in the [[Peace Brigade]]. The Car'das and the Smugglers' Alliance fought alongside the New Republic in the decisive [[Battle of Ebaq]] where they suffered heavy casualties.<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> During the war, Talon Karrde and Car'das also helped [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Invasion of Yavin 4|evacuate]] the [[Jedi Praxeum]] from [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>
